title: The village smith
scene: Open-sided bamboo and thatch smithy: one adult smith holds a dull-red agricultural blade on a compact iron anvil with long tongs while another raises a hand hammer at a safe distance. Small charcoal hearth, simple manual bellows, plough fittings and sickles nearby. Restrained sparks, no molten steel spectacle.
uncertainty: Hearth, bellows and tool arrangement are interpretive; occupation documented, specific workshop not authenticated.
